name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 Fast v3 beta
readme:
## Open services

- **Page** — Port `3000`
- **Claude MCP** — Port `3001` (open the Page and copy the Claude connection URL)
- **Comfy** — Port `8188`
- **JupyterLab** — Port `8888`

Kendo MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Turbo studio v3 beta.12: the v2 generation stack (SageAttention, Turbo LoRA, 9 image / 1 video / 3 audio references, seed lock) plus an in-Pod MCP server so Claude Desktop or Claude Code can upload references from URLs and generate videos through chat. Models download in parallel with resume support to /workspace on first launch. Existing v1/v2 releases remain unchanged.
